name: batch_tools
description: Run 1..20 read-only calls on one Go snapshot with only two full freshness scans. Inspect outer fresh and per-item errors; control/nested calls forbidden; 512 KiB items budget.

name: audit_document
description: Audit Markdown Go links and symbol references against the current snapshot. Does not verify business prose or rewrite documents.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: verify_evidence
description: Check source claims (symbol/file/lines/expected_text/source_hash); find uniquely moved text anchors. Source validation is not semantic proof.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: trace_field
description: Bounded field read/write trace from an entry function through calls. Candidate paths optional. Does not prove same object or execution order.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: project_status
description: RiskLens: current Go environment, load diagnostics and disk freshness.

name: index_status
description: RiskLens: snapshot, lexical/vector readiness, progress, cache hits and errors.

name: refresh_index
description: RiskLens: start asynchronous disk refresh; poll index_status. Rebuilds semantic analysis and reuses content-addressed embeddings.

name: search_symbols
description: Find definitions. Use owner_id=<returned type ID>, kind=field for direct/promoted fields with canonical IDs. Never construct symbol IDs; independent of embeddings.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: get_symbol
description: Read an exact definition. Struct types also return canonical direct/promoted fields in meta.fields. Copy these field IDs for find_field_accesses.

freshness.description: Snapshot skips disk checks and returns fresh=false. Outside project_map supply index_snapshot. Strict verifies saved files.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: find_references
description: Find typed uses, with root-relative 1-based positions.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: get_callers
description: Find confirmed callers and possible interface callers; inspect resolution.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: get_callees
description: List calls in a function; function variables may be unresolved; graph is incomplete.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: find_field_accesses
description: Find typed field accesses and bounded SSA alias candidates. Inspect resolution/analysis; not complete object or value history.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: rule_membership
description: Inspect direct slice return expressions of a named Go function or method. Reports explicit named elements, empty returns and unknowns with lexical guards; does not infer execution or business approval.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: resolve_reference
description: Resolve exact Go field names/typed paths or JSON declaration aliases. Scope with returned owner_id; preserves ambiguity/case. Not runtime object or JSON serialization path proof.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: project_map
description: Discover packages, or traverse a bounded subgraph by node_id. Includes in-module imports, main/init, interfaces and typed implementations. Defaults to fast snapshot reads (fresh=false); use freshness=strict for disk validation.

freshness.description: Snapshot skips disk checks and returns fresh=false. Outside project_map supply index_snapshot. Strict verifies saved files.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

node_id.description: Copy a node ID returned by project_map. Omit for paginated package discovery.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of package path; use only for package discovery.

name: list_files
description: List indexed root-relative file paths, total_lines, bytes and hashes. Paginated: always follow next_cursor if truncated; use for inventory before get_source.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

name: get_source
description: Read indexed source. Default 40 lines; end_line=-1 reads to EOF within byte budget. Returns total_lines/eof/next_line; ranges past EOF are clamped.

end_line.description: 1-based inclusive; -1 means EOF; 0/omitted means at most 40 lines. Past EOF is clamped; byte limit still applies.

freshness.description: Snapshot skips disk checks and returns fresh=false. Outside project_map supply index_snapshot. Strict verifies saved files.

start_line.description: 1-based; 0/omitted defaults to 1. Use list_files for total_lines.

name: search_code
description: Hybrid RRF of symbol/text/vector and package context, or lexical/vector mode. Similarity is not business confidence.

freshness.description: Snapshot skips disk checks and returns fresh=false. Outside project_map supply index_snapshot. Strict verifies saved files.

limit.description: Page size, not total results. 0/omitted uses default; server max_results defaults to 100. Follow next_cursor.

package_context.description: Default true. Use matching package GoDoc as a bounded ranking signal in lexical/hybrid search.

name: build_context
description: Bounded relationship expansion. Returns reasons, sources and omitted IDs for continuation. UTF-8 byte budget, not Qwen tokens.
